intro.data: A Maybe is a box that holds a value or nothing. The most basic move is 'return': take a plain value and wrap it as a box that DEFINITELY holds it (Just the value). The tray holds two machines — one that does that, one that drops the value and hands back an empty box. Bring the faithful return onto the board and wire it, leaving the impostor in the tray.
intro.alchemy: A Vial holds one material or is empty. The most basic move is to Seal: take a material and put it in a vial that DEFINITELY holds it. The tray holds two apparatus — one that does that, one that spills it and hands back an empty vial. Bring the faithful seal onto the board and wire it, leaving the impostor in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: A Charm holds one essence or is dark. The most basic move is to Inscribe: take an essence and bind it into a charm that DEFINITELY holds it. The tray holds two runes — one that does that, one that lets it fizzle into a dark charm. Bring the faithful inscribe onto the board and wire it, leaving the impostor in the tray.
intro.abstract: Just x means the value x is present; Nothing means absent; return (η : A → T(A)) wraps x as Just x. From the tray bring η and wire A to T(A); the impostor has the same type but sends 3 to Nothing, so leave it behind.

goal.data: Bring the right machine from the tray and wire the user into a box that holds it (Just the user).
goal.alchemy: Bring the right apparatus from the tray and seal the herb into a vial that holds it.
goal.spellcraft: Bring the right rune from the tray and inscribe the rune into a charm that holds it.
goal.abstract: Bring η from the tray and wire A to T(A), sending 3 ↦ Just 3.

description.data: a plain value, not yet boxed
description.alchemy: a plain material, not yet sealed
description.spellcraft: a plain essence, not yet bound

description.data: a box that holds a user, or nothing
description.alchemy: a vial that holds a herb, or is empty
description.spellcraft: a charm that holds a rune, or is dark

description.data: wraps the value as a box that holds it (Just)
description.alchemy: seals the material into a full vial
description.spellcraft: binds the essence into a holding charm
description.abstract: wraps a value: sends 3 ↦ Just 3 (the unit η)

description.data: same type, but throws the value away — an empty box
description.alchemy: same type, but spills it — an empty vial
description.spellcraft: same type, but lets it fizzle — a dark charm
description.abstract: drops the value: sends 3 ↦ Nothing (should wrap as Just 3)

afterSuccess.data: 'return' wrapped the user into a box that holds it — Just the user. It's the most trivial way to put a value into the monad: no processing, just packaging. The 'Drop' look-alike had the right type but threw the value away.
afterSuccess.alchemy: 'Seal' put the herb into a full vial — the most trivial way to box it. The 'Spill' look-alike had the right type but emptied it.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: 'Inscribe' bound the rune into a holding charm — the most trivial way to box it. The 'Fizzle' look-alike had the right type but lost it.
afterSuccess.abstract: η : A → T(A) injects a value as the trivial T-structure around it — the unit of the monad.

reveal.summary: return (the unit η : A → T(A)) puts a plain value into the box in the most trivial way — no effect, just packaging. It's one of the two pieces of a monad.
